introduction: The Spanish SBA involves oral and written tasks that demonstrate language proficiency in a variety of contexts. It contributes to the final grade.

tasks.title: Written Component
tasks.explanation: A report or project based on a cultural theme or personal experience.

tasks.title: Oral Task
tasks.explanation: A conversation or presentation in Spanish.

tasks.title: Reflection
tasks.explanation: A reflection on the learning process.

sampleTitle: Una investigación sobre la importancia de la música en la cultura de México.

sample.body: México es un país con una rica tradición musical. Desde el Mariachi hasta la música pop moderna, el ritmo es parte de la vida diaria. Investigué esto leyendo sobre la historia de la música ranchera.
sample.tips: Use a variety of tenses (present, past) in your report.

sample.body: Para este proyecto, escuché muchas canciones mexicanas. Aprendí vocabulario nuevo y mejoré mi comprensión auditiva.
sample.tips: Speak clearly and focus on pronunciation during the oral phase.

marking: Grammatical accuracy, vocabulary range, and fluency in the oral component are the key areas for assessment.
